_comment: Themed word-list generation (word search and other grid puzzles). varietyHints are rotated by seed and are always subordinate to the user's theme.
varietyHints: favour the most typical everyday examples first
include a mix of living things and objects when the theme allows both
favour things you would physically see or touch in that setting
include a few slightly less obvious but still clearly on-theme examples
favour concrete nouns over abstract ideas
lean toward items an older adult would know from daily life
vary across different parts or moments of the theme
prefer plain single words over specialised jargon
